sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We can accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms at a unit price of €52.30.
We kindly request substantiation regarding the alternative source you mentioned, as our long-standing partnership relies on transparency.
Alternatively, with valid from 1 February 2027: €52.30 per unit.
Please send us the competing offer you mentioned.
Please send us the second-source quote you mentioned.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot.
Our terms: a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
We have already taken that notice period data into account.
We note that your proposed price has decreased despite no new information being provided.
As requested previously, please provide the competing quote so we can verify your claims regarding a second source.
Until then, our offer of €52.30 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms remains firm.
Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.
We have supplied you reliably for years and expect fairness in return.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We have already taken that notice period data into account. 

We note that you have lowered your proposed price again without providing the requested substantiation. Without the competing quote to verify your claims regarding a second source, we cannot adjust our pricing. Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Our offer of €52.30 for a 24-month contract with 60-day payment terms is our final offer. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
